gold: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising in a seborrheic keratosis of the eyelid

selector.rationale: The presence of a hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts, proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells, and malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli support the diagnosis of Squamous cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The histopathological examination does not support the diagnosis of Basal cell carcinoma, and the presence of malignant squamous cells and pseudohorn cysts contradicts this diagnosis.
